title: Marcus Georgio
summary: The colonel who commands the Molossi during Compromised's Gulf Coast crisis.

claims.text: Compromised identifies Colonel Marcus Georgio as commander of the Molossi, a force that consolidates around Dallas-Fort Worth before moving toward the Gulf Coast.
The novel reveals that rogue agents coerce Georgio's expansion by threatening his captured son, David Georgio.

paragraphs.text: Georgio presents the Molossi as protectors, but their rapid entry into refinery communities makes them a competing power center in the crisis.
The book eventually shows that the rogue cell has exploited Georgio's concern for David to direct the Molossi's territorial moves.

verification.notes: The coercion and family connection are major plot spoilers from the licensed novel.
